name: label-fit
title: Label fit
description: What a control does with a label too long for it: wrap between words, set the type smaller first, or cut to one line; shorten a person's name to "J. Verhoeven" only when it does not fit; and give every label in a group the same size and line count so their text starts at one height. Resolved once when the group lays out, never during play. Used by Choice and Button.
docs: Settings, as props on Choice and Button or app-wide through <LabelFitProvider settings={{ ... }}>: labelFit 'wrap' | 'shrink' | 'truncate' (default wrap); maxLines 1 | 2 | 3 (default 2, then an ellipsis); minLines, the lines every label is given room for whatever it needs, so one-line and two-line names make controls of one height (Choice defaults it to maxLines, Button to 1); shrinkFloor, the smallest the type may shrink to as a fraction of its size (default 0.85, never below 17px); nameFormat 'full' | 'initial' | 'surname' (default full, falling back to initial only when the full name does not fit); groupFit 'uniform' | 'each' (default uniform: every label in the group gets the same size and line count); fitGroup, an id that makes several groups on one screen share one fit (default none). Names are shortened only for options marked kind: 'person' (Button: labelKind='person'); the accessible name is always the full label.
